title: op.lnot / OP_lnot attribution
nature: profiling only; no src change shipped; stops at the decision point

binaries.zjs_counter_build_flags: -Dzjs_enable_opcode_profile=true plus a temporary counter; NEVER used for any timing number

host.topology: 20-core big.LITTLE, two PMUs; every event carries a PMU prefix

mechanism.zjs_registration: src/exec/tailcall_dispatch_colds.zig:309 -- op.lnot is the cold-table entry only; there is no fast handler
mechanism.zjs_helper: src/exec/vm_value.zig:235 noinline fn logicalNot -> core.value_semantics.toBoolean (a SECOND out-of-line call)
mechanism.zjs_existing_immediate_predicate: src/core/value.zig:450 JSValue.asBranchImmediateBool -- already a verbatim mirror of the qjs arm, already used by op_if_false8/op_if_true8, not used by lnot
mechanism.qjs_peephole: none -- OP_lnot appears only at 19092 (interpreter) and 27620 (emitter); resolve_labels never rewrites it

syntactic_forms_emitting_op_lnot.measured_with: temporary tag census, 1000 evaluations per form
syntactic_forms_emitting_op_lnot.conclusion: zjs has NO condition-context inversion peephole: a `!` in a condition still executes op.lnot. A source-level `!` census would therefore have been nearly right for zjs, but every number below is from the dynamic counter regardless.

stage_attribution.period_policy: fixed co-prime periods only (P7-42 -F aliasing hazard)
